crossRefs.note: Hear Yahweh’s word, O house of Jacob, and all the families of the house of Israel!
Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for Yahweh has spoken.
‘Hear Yahweh’s word, king of Judah, who sits on David’s throne, you, your servants, and your people who enter in by…
now therefore hear Yahweh’s word, O remnant of Judah: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘If you indeed set…
Micaiah said, “Therefore hear Yahweh’s word. I saw Yahweh sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by…
“Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.
Hear Yahweh’s word, you rulers of Sodom! Listen to the law of our God, you people of Gomorrah!
Therefore hear Yahweh’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:
Hear Yahweh’s word, you children of Israel; for Yahweh has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: “Indeed there…
Now therefore listen to Yahweh’s word: ‘You say, Don’t prophesy against Israel, and don’t preach against the house of…
For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you…
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

people.name: Israel

translations.web: Hear the word which Yahweh speaks to you, house of Israel!

translations.kjv: Hear ye the word which the LORD speaketh unto you, O house of Israel:
